= AWS Timestream
:artifactid: camel-aws2-timestream-starter

Write records to and query the time-series data of Amazon Timestream for LiveAnalytics, and manage its databases, tables, batch load tasks and scheduled queries.

== What's inside

* xref:{csb-camel-components}::aws2-timestream-component.adoc[AWS Timestream component], URI syntax: `aws2-timestream:clientType:label`

Please refer to the above links for usage and configuration details.

== Maven coordinates

[source,xml]
----
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.camel.springboot</groupId>
    <artifactId>camel-aws2-timestream-starter</artifactId>
</dependency>
----
